backend/main.mo: Actor exposes a single shared function returning the caller's principal.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing deployment- and custom-domain–related features, their associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend source file in the quiz app.
frontend/CUSTOM_DOMAIN_DEPLOYMENT.md: Guide explaining how the app is configured for the custom domain via the .well-known/ic-domains file.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining OKLCH color variables, theme tokens, and light/dark mode styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/PLAY_STORE_TWA_PUBLISHING_GUIDE: Guide for publishing the web app to Google Play using a Trusted Web Activity and Bubblewrap.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Contains the single custom domain used for IC domain verification.
frontend/README.md: Project documentation covering quiz features, question file formats, deployment steps, and backend canister configuration.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing authentication, quiz flow, question loading, state transitions, and screen routing.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundMusicC: Component providing mute toggle and volume slider controls for background music.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmModal.tsx: Reusable confirmation dialog component for actions like canceling the quiz.
Small UI component for displaying footnote-style callouts with optional titles.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component handling header UI, quiz level tabs, authentication buttons, and background music controls.
frontend/src/components/ProgressIndicato: Displays quiz progress using a percentage label and progress bar.
frontend/src/components/QuizLevelTabs.ts: Provides buttons to switch between class-level quiz categories.
frontend/src/components/ReadingPanel.tsx: Shows main reading content with an optional footnote section.
frontend/src/data/questions_class10.js: Provides Class 10 science quiz questions organized by units with indexed correct answers.
frontend/src/data/questions_class7.js: Holds Class 7 science quiz questions grouped by units with correct answer indices.
frontend/src/data/questions_class8.js: Includes Class 8 science quiz questions covering multiple units with structured options and answers.
frontend/src/data/questions_class9.js: Exports an array of Class 9 quiz questions with options, answers, and units.
frontend/src/data/questions.js: Contains Class 6 science quiz questions with units, options, and correct answers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Provides a hook to control looping background audio with play, pause, volume, mute, and unlock features.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an authentication provider and hook for managing Internet Identity login state and stored identities.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and custom CSS variables for a pastel gamified theme with light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/quiz/committedCounts.ts: Computes counts of correct and wrong committed quiz answers, treating null answers as wrong.
frontend/src/quiz/loadQuestions.ts: Loads and validates quiz questions for a given class level with error handling for missing files.
frontend/src/quiz/scoring.ts: Calculates quiz results including total questions, correct answers, and score percentage.
frontend/src/quiz/types.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for quiz questions, answers, state, and scoring results.
frontend/src/quiz/validateQuestions.ts: Validates and normalizes quiz question objects, ensuring required fields and matching correct answers by index or text.
frontend/src/screens/LoginRequiredScreen: Displays a login prompt using Internet Identity with animated UI elements and error handling.
frontend/src/screens/QuestionScreen.tsx: Renders an interactive timed question interface with answer submission, auto‑timeout, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/screens/ResultsScreen.tsx: Shows final quiz results with score calculation, performance messaging, and options to restart or review answers.
frontend/src/screens/ReviewScreen.tsx: Provides a scrollable review of all questions, showing correct answers and the user's responses.
frontend/src/screens/StartScreen.tsx: Displays quiz introduction, stats, and settings including shuffle and background music before starting.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, fonts, radii, shadows, and animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks deployment state, issues, and feature requests for the Internet Computer app, including plans to redeploy to a new canister and update frontend configuration.
